Bill.BriefDescription: Regulating distribution of communications by state employees.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to distribution of communications by stateemployees; and adding a new section to chapter 42.52 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 42.52 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Nothing in this chapter prohibits a state employee fromdistributing communications from an employee organization or charitableorganization to other state employees if the communications do notsupport or oppose a ballot proposition or candidate for state or localpublic office.
